narration.full_text: Namaste students! Welcome to an exciting journey into the world of "Control and Coordination." In this chapter, we will explore how living organisms manage and integrate their various activities to respond to the environment and ensure their survival. Get ready to understand the fascinating mechanisms that keep life in balance!
